# Study Time Statistics 2.4.0

## 中文

- 新增“注意力地图”，按时长、打开次数、阅读覆盖和最近阅读查看注意力分布。
- 支持逐层进入文件夹，并从地图直接打开笔记。
- 新增常见学习路径，统计连续阅读笔记之间的本地跳转关系。
- 地图只使用当前仓库中的本地路径，不含预设个人分类，也不上传数据。
- “投入分布”会纳入尚未阅读的 Markdown/PDF 笔记，并正确累计多次阅读覆盖记录。

## English

- Adds an Attention Map with time, opens, reading coverage, and recency modes.
- Supports folder drill-down and opening source notes directly from the map.
- Adds frequent study paths derived from consecutive local reading sessions.
- The map uses only paths from the current vault, with no preset personal categories or uploads.
- Investment view now includes unread Markdown/PDF notes and correctly combines repeated coverage entries.
